title: Synergy run-rate uncertified at BAU handover
notes: Design §B.4: blocks IMO demobilization — the BAU exit is a completeness fact, not a judgment call (same logic as PR-10's financing precondition). THRESHOLD UPDATE (2026-08-24): the certification criteria are DECIDED by docs/decisions/2026-08-24-class-c-decisions.md (anchor gd-0024-class-c-decisions) — certified = >=90% of committed COST-synergy run-rate in annualized P&L actuals vs the close-locked baseline, sustained 2 consecutive quarters (or 3 monthly closes), CFO-signed package with owner countersignatures; baseline changes post-close need CFO approval + disclosure. The VAR half (pmi.synergy_run_rate_certified) needs certification-recording schema — entry stays inert until its extension round per ADR-0060 §3. Declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until that record exists (activation convention per ADR-0057). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: pmi.synergy_run_rate_certified (boolean); was 'criteria pending open question (c)' — now decided.
